# Border

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Represents border widths for the four sides of an element. All values are in points (1/72 inch).

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new Border(float width)
new Border(float left, float top, float right, float bottom)
```

## Properties

- [`Bottom`](#bottom): Border width on the bottom side, in points.
- [`HasAnyBorder`](#hasanyborder): Checks if any side has a border width greater than zero
- [`HorizontalWidth`](#horizontalwidth): Total horizontal border width (left + right)
- [`Left`](#left): Border width on the left side, in points.
- [`None`](#none): No border (all sides zero)
- [`Right`](#right): Border width on the right side, in points.
- [`Top`](#top): Border width on the top side, in points.
- [`VerticalWidth`](#verticalwidth): Total vertical border width (top + bottom)
